name: demo
_note: A minimal CUSTOMER protocol for the first live end-to-end: one dispatched CODE node (facts) -> one AGENT node (summarize) -> done. Both nodes run through act inside a disposable sbx microVM. `summarize` consumes `facts`'s evidence via inputs and echoes the token it received; each node's check settles a SELF-CONTAINED claim from that node's own evidence (the real check ABI passes evidence + the MR diff, not a sibling node's evidence). Trigger `/demo` on an MR comment.

states.label: facts (dispatched code, under act in a microVM)
summarize (agent, under act in a microVM)
